viewing_check: Look for a maker plate or stamping (Lucas, Powell & Hanmer, Miller, Badger) on the body, generator and bezel; check lens glass and reflector are present and intact, that the generator screws on and the burner and drip valve are complete; check for solder repairs and size (larger car lamps are worth more than cycle lamps).
